BlockRef.title: blockRef
BlockRef.description: Object defining block references. At least one of `blockHash` or `blockNumber` must be present; the node rejects an object carrying neither with `Invalid block input`.

requireCanonical.title: requireCanonical
requireCanonical.description: Whether a block that is not on the canonical chain is acceptable. Send it as the JSON string `"true"` or `"false"`, not as a JSON boolean: the node reads the whole object as a map of strings, so a non-string value fails during deserialisation, before this field is inspected. A string other than those two is rejected with `Invalid input: requireCanonical must be a String "true" or "false"`. It is only consulted alongside `blockHash`; when it is `"true"` and the referenced block is not on the canonical chain, the node answers with a block-not-found error stating the block is not canonical.
